analysis_contract.final_training: all development rows (screening + previously inspected v3 confirmation); no final tuning
analysis_contract.holdout: only one scheduled scoring pass of all prespecified fixed candidates, no ranking-based reselection
analysis_contract.regression: MAE primary, RMSE/R2 secondary; paired exact-input-pattern bootstrap CI descriptive
analysis_contract.classification: macro-F1 primary, hazardous recall/balanced accuracy/ordinal error secondary; paired exact-input-pattern bootstrap CI descriptive
analysis_contract.calibration: descriptive, no post-hoc threshold or calibration tuning on holdout
analysis_contract.historical_data: old historical test and v3 confirmation already inspected; new outer holdout is NOT an independent external dataset
analysis_contract.selection_after_holdout: PROHIBITED; rerunning skips prior holdout scoring if receipt exists

screening_source: verified v4 screening-only grouped OOF and rankings; feature and model choices frozen before target access
